🦃 Psst… you found it.

You've just stumbled onto a TOP SECRET Friendsgiving scavenger hunt. 9 more QR codes are hidden around this house. Find them all, in order, and glory (plus 3 raffle tickets) is yours.

How it works:
🔍 Each clue leads you to the next hidden QR code.
🔑 Each clue ends with a secret code. Remember it! The next QR code won't open without it.
🤫 Keep it hush-hush. Don't give away hiding spots; let everyone else sweat a little.
🙌 Leave every QR code exactly where you found it, and put things back how they were.
🐈 Be gentle with the cats' stuff. They did not agree to this.

Ready? Here's your first clue:

You've already met one mirror. Now go where we eat and find a matching pair of twins hanging on the wall. 🪞
